notes.title: Patch Notes for Nightmare Update
notes.content: Prevent skipping of intentionally unskippable cutscenes that caused a soft-lock, including the final ending.

notes.title: The 'Nightmare' Update
Smol demo update
notes.content:
Adds some features to the Demo menu that are present in the main game, primarily:

 Slider to reduce screen shake when angry
 Additional 'skip' option in dialogue speed


There were also a couple of small bug fixes for certain elements not colliding with the mouse cursor correctly

notes.title: Bug fixes n' more
notes.content:
Here's a round of bug fixes and quality of life changes, on the house!

Bug fixes:

 Fixed potentially game-breaking bug to do with stacked items being added from the quickbar to the longcase
 Added some missing interaction text


Patches:

 Items will only be added back to the world if dropped onto the item they were originally placed on
 Improved some grammar

notes.title: Printersim update
notes.content:
Below is the changelog:

Features:

 Added an option for adjusting the intensity of the screen shake when angry


Patches:

 Resized some hitboxes
 Printer cartridges now easier to place in the holder
 Some shadows and lights effects now do not count as part of the item


Bugfixes:

 Fixed the inventory falsely flagging up as full
 Fixed stacks of items being reduced to 1 sometimes
